zones.label: Terrain map layouts (table entries, not named zones)

looks.label: Mask-blended ground
looks.technique: one greyscale mask per terrain tile; the exporter writes the mask only, the blend shader is in the client (not in repo, not read)

looks.label: Texture row order
looks.technique: stored upside down; first pixel is lower-left (pipeline check on import)

looks.label: Text-form mesh export
looks.technique: mesh exported as Blender Python script (pipeline idea: keep a text mesh form, use glTF JSON for us)

originals.name: Layered ground by mask
originals.idea: one greyscale mask per tile drives two or more ground textures, giving many biome edges from few textures
originals.keep: greyscale mask per tile over layered textures
originals.change: our tile size, our own mask shapes, a palette per zone

originals.name: Zone as a grid spec
originals.idea: a zone is a width by height grid of tiles, declared as one data row
originals.keep: start index, width, height and ordering in one record
originals.change: named zones; a size ladder (1x1 camp, 8x8 field, 16x16 region); load-time overlap check

originals.name: Hidden keepsake
originals.idea: an optional find off the main route with a short note or picture
originals.keep: optional, off-route, rewards exploring, does not change the quest path
originals.change: our own text and art, placed by zone designers; no donor content

originals.name: Readable mesh pack
originals.idea: meshes stored as an editable text file for review and diffs
originals.change: glTF JSON with our naming and LOD fields

originals.name: Archive with directory
originals.idea: many small resources in one archive with a directory of offset, size and stored size
originals.keep: directory entries; stored-as-is when compression does not help
